intentions.title: One headless-CMS core context layer (Content, Tenancy, Auth, Access, Media) that every surface — API, Studio, TUI, SDKs — reads and writes through, never around
intentions.evidence: content.ex delegates to Content.{Query,Mutations,Writer,Lifecycle,Search,Export,Papers,...}; Plugin @moduledoc forbids plugins from importing Barkpark.Repo directly ('bypasses the draft-prefix logic, lifecycle-hook dispatcher, PubSub broadcast, webhook dispatcher'); Tenancy, Media, Access, Auth are all separate contexts plugins/controllers call into rather than touching Ecto schemas directly.

intentions.title: Sanity-style draft/published document model with three read perspectives (published/drafts/raw), enforced uniformly at the query layer
intentions.evidence: content.ex moduledoc: 'drafts.{id}' vs published id convention; list_documents/get_document accept :perspective opt; publish_document/unpublish_document/discard_draft in api/CLAUDE.md; drafts perspective merges via SQL DISTINCT ON.

intentions.title: Workspace -> Project -> Dataset tenancy hierarchy with a hard, additive scoping boundary on every read/write path (content, media, webhooks, access grants)
intentions.evidence: tenancy.ex Workspace/Project/Dataset/Membership/Organization contexts; content.ex list_documents docstring 'Tenancy scoping (Wave 1 hard boundary)'; webhooks.ex stamp_scope/scope helpers drop client-supplied workspace_id/project_id and stamp server-resolved scope so 'a wsA-scoped admin cannot POST a hook into wsB'; media.ex upload/2 stamps workspace_id/project_id on insert.

intentions.title: Plugins extend the host purely through schemas + pure-function modules and a compile-time manifest — never own UI, routes-at-runtime, or direct Repo access — so a plugin-free install still fully works
intentions.evidence: plugin.ex moduledoc: 'A plugin is schemas + business logic — never UI'; forbidden-surfaces list (no Repo import, no BarkparkWeb.* modules, no runtime Phoenix.Router.routes, no reaching into Registry internals); 'Fresh-install invariant' section requires boot/Studio/public-API to work with `plugins: []`; plugin_free_boot_test.exs regression bar.

intentions.title: Idempotent, self-healing plugin schema registration so schema install never requires manual ops intervention
intentions.evidence: plugin.ex: 'Schema registration is idempotent' — Plugins.Bootstrap.register_all_schemas/0 upserts via Content.upsert_schema/2 idempotent on (name, dataset); a raising plugin callback logs+skips but sibling schemas still install; 'Never reintroduce manual mix run ... registration'.

intentions.title: Pluggable, ETS-backed field/value validation (checkers) that built-ins and plugins share through one namespaced registry, kept hot-path fast and hot-reload safe
intentions.evidence: validation/checker.ex behaviour (@callback check/2); validation/registry.ex GenServer-guarded writes + ETS read-fast find/1, built-in isbn13/gtin14/iso639/iso4217/nonempty checkers, plugin checkers namespaced 'plugin:<name>:<checker>' to avoid collision, reload_plugin_checkers/0 called on plugin registry boot.

intentions.title: Time-boxed, scope-contained, fail-closed sharing primitives — API tokens, webhooks, and airdrop access grants — so no principal can escalate privilege or exfiltrate data across tenants
intentions.evidence: access.ex: grant mint is checked via Tenancy.Auth.authorize/3 ('no escalation at mint'), claim/2 is atomic (WHERE claimed_at IS NULL), scope ladder [:workspace_id,:project_id,:dataset,:type,:doc_id] enforces total containment; auth.ex verify_token/1 rejects revoked/expired/wrong-kind tokens indistinguishably from missing ones (no existence leak), login-ticket 60s TTL, share-edit tokens capped at 1 year; webhooks.ex secret/scope are immutable on update except through rotate_secret/3.

intentions.title: A generic, schema-driven Studio navigation tree (tiered desk: Main / Plugins / …Rest) that never hides a document type and stays backward-compatible with old Go TUI clients
intentions.evidence: structure.ex moduledoc describes three tiers built from ONLY existing node types so 'old Go TUI binaries render every tier without a client change'; …Rest tier guarantees every doc type in a dataset appears somewhere via Analytics.type_census/2, 'the tree never silently hides a doc type, it only organizes it'.
